scripts.build: pnpm --filter @crewdesk/web build:prod && pnpm --filter @crewdesk/api build && node scripts/prune-old-builds.mjs
scripts.demo: node scripts/wait-for-db.mjs && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && echo '… Building Crewdesk (1–3 minutes). Until it says it is running, the web address shows "unable to handle this request".' && pnpm build && NODE_ENV=production node apps/api/dist/main.js
